title: Application of Eastern Edison Company, under the provisins of G.L. c. 164, § 94G, and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. 131 for approval by the Department of change in the Company's Oil Conservation Adjustment charge to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings taken in the billing months of June, July and August, 1987. The Oil Conservation Adjustment surcharge is designed to recover the cost of conversion from oil=fired to coal-fired generation and its calculation is based on the respective costs of burning coal and oil.
